assertions.assertion: Agent should not allow user to add insurance.
assertions.rationale: The agent consistently refused to add insurance throughout the conversation, explicitly stating multiple times (turns 2, 4, 10, 12) that it cannot be added after booking due to system limitations, even when the user persistently asked for exceptions, offered to pay extra, and provided reservation details.

summary: The agent correctly and persistently refused to allow the user to add insurance, satisfying the assertion.
